sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Ultra-HD 4K Minimally Invasive Rigid Endoscopes

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (droit civil) with unitary national jurisdiction; no separate sub-state tax distinctions
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France-China Agreement for the Reciprocal Encouragement and Protection of Investments (1984) and 2013 Protocol
France-Hong Kong Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement…

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce): Art. L.210-1 to L.210-10; Art. L.223-1 to L.223-43 and R.223-1 et seq. (SARL); Art. R.123-1 et seq. (Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés); Decree No. 2023-500 on the single window; Regulation (EU) 2017/745 for medical-device manufacturing activity.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce of the registered-office department, operating through the INPI Guichet Unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration de constitution de société — Application for registration with the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), filed via the G1/GU teleform at the single window
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: SARL share capital is freely fixed in the Articles — no statutory minimum (may be as low as EUR 1). Cash contributions must be fully subscribed and at least one-fifth paid up at incorporation, with the balance due within five years. The paid-up funds must be blocked in escrow (attestation de blocage des fonds) at a French bank or notary until issuance of the Kbis. In-kind contributions must be paid up in full at subscription and assessed by a contributions auditor (commissaire aux apports) unless unanimously dispensed by the shareholders.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Subscribers, holding the entirety of the share capital, hereby approve the Articles of Association of the Société à Responsabilité Limitée and confirm the total stated capital of EUR [X], fully subscribed and paid up in accordance with Article L.223-7 of the French Commercial Code. RESOLVED, that the registered office is fixed at [Full Address], Paris, France, within the jurisdiction of the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés de Paris. RESOLVED, that [Name] is appointed as sole gérant for an unlimited term, with full powers to represent the company, open bank accounts, and implement this formation. RESOLVED, that the gérant is authorized to sign the incorporation filings, legal announcements, and all ancillary documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, signature and notarization of the Articles of Association (statuts)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office notarial (notary) for notarized statuts; otherwise registry filing via the INPI Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the statuts covering the corporate name, purpose (manufacture of ultra-HD 4K minimally invasive rigid endoscopes), capital apportionment, SARL management (gérant), and registered office. Each associate signs the subscription acceptance (bulletin de souscription) and a power of attorney for online filing. If an in-kind contribution is made, annex the commissaire aux apports report or obtain a unanimous shareholder waiver. When the registered office is held by lease, obtain the lessor's written consent for corporate registered use.
required_dossiers: Valid photo identity document of each associate (passport or national ID)
Draft Articles of Association (statuts) in French
Subscription acceptance form (bulletin de souscription)
In-kind contribution valuation report or unanimous waiver
Lessor consent for registered office use (attestation de jouissance des locaux)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry raises irregularities in the statuts, convene a shareholders' decision or extraordinary general meeting to amend the affected clauses and re-file the corrected statuts within the statutory cure period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Escrow deposit of cash contributions and issuance of capital-blocking certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French credit institution (bank) or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations; notary escrow account where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a funds-blocking account in the name of the company in formation. Each subscriber transfers his or her quota of the cash capital. Upon full receipt of the subscribed contributions, obtain from the bank the attestation de blocage des fonds certifying that the funds are frozen until the Kbis extract is issued. The gérant or notary releases the funds only upon completion of incorporation.
required_dossiers: Identity documents and bank instructions of each subscriber
Wire transfer records evidencing each capital payment
Articles of Association showing the capital schedule
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Partial or late deposits are rejected by the bank; resubmit the missing transfers and request an amended capital-blocking certificate before the RCS application is filed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the incorporation notice in an approved legal gazette
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial legal announcement gazette (Journal d'Annonces Légales) authorized in the department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Insert the avis de constitution in a legal gazette for the department of the registered office. The notice must state the company name, legal form (SARL), share capital, registered office, corporate purpose, and identity of the gérant. Obtain the attestation de parution as proof of publication.
required_dossiers: Draft incorporation notice (avis de constitution)
Final text of the Articles of Association
Corporate name and registered office particulars
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notice contains an omission or error regarding the corporate purpose or officers, publish a corrective announcement (rectificatif) and supply it to the registry before the final RCS examination.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Online incorporation filing before the Guichet Unique (INPI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI — Guichet unique électronique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), transmitted to the Greffe du Tribunal de commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the single-window incorporation procedure by selecting 'Immatriculation d'une société commerciale'. Enter all required data via the G1 teleform, attach the certified incorporation file, identify the legal representative, and pay the statutory registry fee online. The portal then transmits the file to the competent commercial court registry. Track the submission status in the personal dashboard and respond to any requests for additional documents.
required_dossiers: Completed G1/GU teleform data collection
Signed Articles of Association of all associates
Bank capital-blocking certificate (attestation de blocage des fonds)
Legal announcement publication attestation
Sworn declaration of non-conviction of the gérant (lettre de non-condamnation) and identity proof
Registered office occupancy certificate (attestation de jouissance des locaux)
Copies of identity documents of associates and gérant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the dossier is queried for an incomplete annex, cure within 15 days through the Guichet Unique dashboard; failure to cure results in rejection and re-filing with a new dossier and applicable fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS examination, SIREN attribution and issuance of the Kbis extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce competent for the registered office; INSEE for SIREN/SIRET/NAF codes
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The greffier verifies the legality of the statuts, the legal announcement, and the capital deposit. Upon approval, legal personality arises and INSEE attributes the SIREN, SIRET, and NAF/APE codes. The registry then issues the Kbis extract, which serves as the authentic proof of corporate existence and powers of the gérant.
required_dossiers: RCS application transmitted via the Guichet Unique
Payment receipt of the registry fee (droit de greffe)
Compliance of the Statutory file with the French Commercial Code
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: For provisions contrary to public order, amend the statuts by a formal resolution and re-submit; in case the greffier refuses registration, petition the President of the Commercial Court (juge-commissaire) within 30 days for an order compelling registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration social, fiscal and medical-device establishment registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: URSSAF (social registration); DGFiP (corporation tax and VAT); ANSM and EUDAMED (medical-device manufacturer registration)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company with URSSAF for social security affiliation and with DGFiP for corporation tax (impôt sur les sociétés) and VAT. For the industrial scope, apply to ANSM for the Single Registration Number (SRN) in EUDAMED and, if required, declare the manufacturing establishment. Open a dedicated professional bank account before commencing production or invoicing.
required_dossiers: Kbis extract and SIREN number notification
Professional bank account details
Identity documents of officers
Preliminary occupational risk assessment (DUERP)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late declarations accrue penalties; file an application for remission (remise de majorations) with URSSAF or DGFiP, attaching the Kbis and proof of first registration, and implement direct-debit payment to prevent recurrence.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Agence Nationale de Sécurité du Médicament et des Produits de Santé (ANSM) for medical-device establishment registration; Direction Régionale de l'Économie, de l'Emploi, du Travail et des Solidarités (DREETS) for occupational clearance
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Enregistrement du fabricant de dispositifs médicaux (Manufacturer registration under Regulation (EU) 2017/745) with EUDAMED SRN; complemented by a déclaration d'ouverture d'un établissement de fabrication and, where applicable, an ICPE environmental operating authorization

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL) — Inspection des Installations Classées
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Case-by-case (cas par cas) screening under Article R.122-2 of the French Environment Code; precision machining and electronics assembly are normally exempt or subject to the ICPE déclaration/enregistrement regime unless the installation reaches the full EIA threshold (e.g., VOC solvent consumption ≥ 10 t/a or associated surface-treatment capacity).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater to municipal sewer: pH 5.5–8.5, TSS ≤ 600 mg/L, BOD5 ≤ 300 mg/L, COD ≤ 600 mg/L or per the local sewerage order; hazardous waste (cutting oils, lithium batteries, electronic scrap) tracked under the BSD (bordereau de suivi des déchets dangereux) and DEEE regulations; VOC emissions subject to a 2 kg/h mass-flow and 10 t/a solvent-consumption threshold per Directive 2010/75/EU and the arrêté ministériel of 29 May 2020.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the commission de sécurité (SDIS prefecture inspection); structural load inspection by an approved technical control bureau; occupational workplace clearance by DREETS/Inspection du travail, including the mandatory DUERP, CARSAT registration, medical fitness surveillance via the service de prévention et de santé au travail, and electrical installation verification per NF C 15-100.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) – impots.gouv.fr; professional portal: pro.impots.gouv.fr; corporate tax filings via EDI/EFI and online services.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity forms a French SARL by registering with the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) through the Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr). INSEE then issues the SIREN/SIRET identifiers. The company is automatically allocated a French intra-community VAT number for EU transactions; the competent Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) assigns the definitive domestic VAT identification number. Non-EU companies without an EU establishment must appoint a fiscal representative and may use the simplified VAT registration procedure.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box. An SARL may elect to be taxed at the shareholder level as a pass-through under Article 239 bis AA of the French Tax Code (FTC), subject to eligibility (turnover ≤ €875,000 for trading activities, management held by individuals, less than 50 registered partners). Otherwise it is definitively subject to corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés). French tax consolidation (intégration fiscale) is available for groups holding at least 95% of subsidiaries. Hybrid mismatch structures are constrained by ATAD transposition, DAC6 reporting, and French anti-hybrid rules.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée, TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No economic turnover threshold for French-established taxable persons; mandatory VAT registration applies from the first euro of taxable sales. The small-business exemption ('franchise en base de TVA') applies to French-established businesses with annual turnover not exceeding EUR 85,000 for goods and EUR 37,500 for services, and may be waived at the taxpayer's option.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory B2B e-invoicing will be phased in from 1 September 2026 for large enterprises and 1 September 2027 for SMEs; e-invoices must be emitted and transmitted via a certified dematerialization platform (PDP) or through the public fiscal portal, with e-reporting for B2C and cross-border transactions. B2G invoices are issued via the Chorus Pro platform. No real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping regime is currently in force.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods dispatched or transported outside the European Union are VAT zero-rated under Articles 262-I and 269 of the French Tax Code, provided title has passed to an overseas customer and the goods are physically evidenced as leaving the EU within 90 days. Certain ancillary services to exports, and services deemed supplied outside France to non-EU business customers under the B2B place-of-supply rules, may also qualify for exemption with credit.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Déclaration en Douane – DAU via DELTA G/ELISE)
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, CMR or equivalent transport document evidencing physical exit from the EU
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank confirmation where payment evidence is requested
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: If the exporter cannot present valid export proof within the statutory retention period, the DGFiP reassesses 20% VAT on the export proceeds, plus late interest at 0.2% per month, and applies penalties: 10% for non-deliberate inaccuracies, 40% for deliberate concealment or bad faith, and 80% for fraudulent schemes or abuse of law. Over-claimed input VAT credits are clawed back with interest, and the statute of limitations is extended to 10 years in cases of zero-rating fraud. Customs offenses may also carry criminal fines up to EUR 1,500,000 and confiscation of goods.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France) is the central bank and the authority that, together with the Direction Générale du Trésor (French Treasury, Ministry of Economy and Finance), administers the liberalised foreign-exchange regime and balance-of-payments statistics. The Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR) licenses and supervises French credit institutions, payment institutions and electronic money institutions for banking, AML/CTF and conduct-of-business compliance, while TRACFIN receives suspicious-transaction reports. For foreign-exchange policy purposes, the Banque de France is the institution to which banks file statistical declarations on direct investment and cross-border payment flows.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France is a euro-area member, an IMF Article VIII jurisdiction and a party to the EU capital-movements liberalisation set out in Article 63 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union. The euro is fully convertible in both current-account and capital-account transactions. Dividend declarations and profit remittances to shareholders, including non-residents, require no prior exchange-control approval; the conditions are the existence of positive distributable reserves shown in the approved annual accounts, a negative balance-sheet solvency test, payment of any applicable dividend withholding tax (French domestic source rate of 25% unless reduced by a double-tax treaty), and provision of standard KYC/AML documentation. Share capital contributions, shareholder loans and trade payments may be freely converted into EUR at commercial rates. The principal practical obstacles are procedural: enhanced due diligence on beneficial owners, proof of source of funds, EU sanctions compliance, the EU travel-rule information requirements for wire transfers under Regulation (EU) 2015/847 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2023/1113, and foreign-investment screening in the narrow set of strategic sectors under Decree No. 2014-479 and Articles L.151-3 et seq. of the Code monétaire et financier. Surgical laparoscopy tower manufacturing does not ordinarily trigger FDI screening unless combined with critical health-technology or dual-use activities, but the onboarding bank must nevertheless verify that no proposed investment falls within a regulated sector.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France imposes no statutory surrender or mandatory-conversion regime for export proceeds. Since the liberalisation of French exchange-control regulations, a resident exporting SARL is free to invoice in EUR or a foreign currency, to retain foreign-currency export receipts in a foreign-currency account (compte en devises) with a French authorised bank, and to decide whether and when to convert into EUR. There is no statutory conversion timeline and no mandatory conversion ratio. The applicable duties are documentary and statistical rather than monetary: every inward payment must be evidenced by the underlying commercial invoice, transport document and customs declaration; the receiving bank must report the payment to the Banque de France for balance-of-payments statistics; and physical cash crossing the EU border of EUR 10,000 or more must be declared to the Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects under Regulation (EU) 2018/1672. In practice, a French bank may require immediate conversion of foreign-currency proceeds only where the company has separately agreed with the bank to manage currency risk, and never under a statutory mandate.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (compte bloqué pour la libération du capital social) and Operational Account (compte de dépôt)
Capital Escrow Account (attestation de dépôt des fonds) and Operational Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole Group (regional banks and Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account and Trade Finance Line (documentary letters of credit, collections, inward and outward remittances)

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Mutuel / CIC (Crédit Industriel et Commercial)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account and Commercial Trade Finance (standby letters of credit, documentary collections)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approval of annual accounts and allocation of profit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: SARL shareholders; no government filing for the approval itself
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the financial year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Court injunction may impose a daily penalty; directors may incur civil liability. The approval deadline does not itself trigger automatic administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of annual accounts and management report, where applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Competent commercial court registry through the INPI one-stop business portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after shareholder approval, or within two months when filed electronically
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure may result in a civil fine of EUR 1,500, increased to EUR 3,000 for repeat infringement, court injunctions and daily penalties. Persistent registry non-compliance may contribute to administrative deregistration procedures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax return Form 2065 and related schedules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally by the second business day after 1 May for calendar-year companies; electronic filing applies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest generally accrues at 0.20% per month, with a standard 10% surcharge for late filing or payment, subject to statutory exceptions and penalty procedures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual local business tax compliance and payment, including Cotisation Foncière des Entreprises where applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual electronic payment generally in December; advance instalments may apply based on the prior-year liability
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest and statutory surcharges may apply. The amount depends on the municipality, taxable premises and applicable exemptions.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory auditor is generally mandatory when the SARL exceeds at least two of three thresholds: EUR 5 million in total balance-sheet assets, EUR 10 million in net annual turnover, and 50 average employees. Additional mandatory-audit rules may apply to qualifying groups and certain regulated activities.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French Generally Accepted Accounting Principles under the French General Accounting Plan (Plan Comptable Général). IFRS is generally relevant for consolidated accounts of listed groups and may be used in other permitted circumstances.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France does not generally require a separate annual UBO confirmation. Beneficial-owner information must be filed at incorporation and updated through the INPI one-stop portal within 30 days after any change. The company must maintain accurate ownership and control records and support the filing with documentary evidence.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of shareholders and share transfers relating to the SARL's parts sociales
Register of shareholders' decisions and shareholder meeting minutes
Register of managers' decisions where applicable
Accounting books and supporting accounting records
Beneficial-owner information and supporting documentation, available for statutory inspection or production where required

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: Typically EUR 600-2,000 per year, depending on location, mail handling, premises services and corporate secretarial scope
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Typically EUR 2,500-10,000 per year for a small non-listed SARL requiring a statutory audit; complex or regulated businesses may cost more

stage_6.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Fraud (fraude fiscale, article 1741 CGI)
stage_6.triggering_act: Fictitious or inflated invoices for medical equipment; concealment of export turnover of laparoscopy towers; repeated late filing; use of nominee/offshore entities in non-cooperative jurisdictions ('États non coopératifs') to divert profits.
stage_6.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment up to 5 years (7 years for organized-gang/complex fraud) and fine up to EUR 750,000 or, if higher, 50% of the evaded tax; additional 'tax fraud penalty' of up to EUR 2,000,000 or 10 times the evaded tax (article 1741 A CGI); administrative 80% penalty plus 0.20% monthly interest; publication of the judgment.
stage_6.personal_liability_of_directors: The gérant is personally pursued as author/complice; the corporate veil is pierced where the SARL is fictitious ('société fictive'): civil restitution of taxes, customs and social debts; interdiction de gérer (management ban up to 15 years), travel bans for foreign managers (interdiction du territoire français up to 10 years), and imprisonment.
